arxiv-2102-03811.creator: Abdullah Harmanci, Yosum Kurtulmaz, Burcu Ungor
arxiv-2102-03811.description: Abstract . In this paper, we focus on the duo ring property via quasinilpotent elements which gives a new kind of generalizations of commutativity. We call this kind of ring qnil-duo . Firstly, some properties of quasinilpotents in a ring are provided.

arxiv-2103-07911.title: Mean-field interactions between living cells in linear and nonlinear elastic matrices
arxiv-2103-07911.creator: Chaviva Sirote, Yair Shokef
arxiv-2103-07911.description: Abstract Living cells respond to mechanical changes in the matrix surrounding them by applying contractile forces that are in turn transmitted to distant cells. We calculate the mechanical work that each cell performs in order to deform the matrix, and study how that energy changes when a contracting cell is surrounded by other cells with similar properties and behavior.

arxiv-2211-12946.title: An entropic approach to analyze phase transitions in the q = 3 q=3 Potts model
arxiv-2211-12946.creator: L. S. Ferreira, L. N. Jorge, C. J. DaSilva, A. A. Caparica
arxiv-2211-12946.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by L. S. Ferreira, L. N. Jorge, C. J. DaSilva, A. A. Caparica. Boltzmann’s microcanonical entropy is the link between statistical physics and thermodynamics, forasmuch as the behavior of any thermodynamic quantity is directly related to the number of microscopic configurations. Accordingly, in this work, we investigate the behavior of the logarithm of the density of states of the three-state Potts model with an external field applied to one of the states using joint entropic simulations based on the Wang-Landau algorithm.

arxiv-2308-00267.title: Black hole perturbations in spatially covariant gravity with just two tensorial degrees of freedom
arxiv-2308-00267.creator: Jin Saito, Tsutomu Kobayashi
arxiv-2308-00267.description: Abstract We study linear perturbations around a static and spherically symmetric black hole solution in spatially covariant gravity with just two tensorial degrees of freedom. In this theory, gravity modification is characterized by a single time-dependent function that appears in the coefficient of K 2 K^{2} in the action, where K K is the trace of the extrinsic curvature.

arxiv-2508-03967.creator: Mamadou Keita, Wassim Hamidouche, Hessen Bougueffa Eutamene, Abdelmalik Taleb-Ahmed, Abdenour Hadid
arxiv-2508-03967.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce RAVID, the first framework for AI-generated image detection that leverages visual rag ( rag ). arxiv-2601-02306.title: Cold-Starting Podcast Ads and Promotions with Multi-Task Learning on Spotify Conference: Proceedings of the Nineteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining; February 22–26, 2026; Boise, ID, USA Proceedings of the Nineteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mi
arxiv-2601-02306.creator: Shivam Verma, Hannes Karlbom, Yu Zhao, Nick Topping, Vivian Chen, Kieran Stanley, Bharath Rengarajan
arxiv-2601-02306.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Shivam Verma, Hannes Karlbom, Yu Zhao, Nick Topping, Vivian Chen, Kieran Stanley, Bharath Rengarajan. We present a unified multi-objective model for targeting both advertisements and promotions within the Spotify podcast ecosystem. Our approach addresses key challenges in personalization and cold-start initialization, particularly for new advertising objectives. By leveraging transfer learning from large-scale ad and content interactions within a multi-task learning (MTL) framework, a single joint model can be fine-tuned or directly applied to new or low-data targeting tasks, including in-app promotions.

arxiv-2602-23601.title: Extended Reality (XR): The Next Frontier in Education
arxiv-2602-23601.creator: Shadeeb Hossain
arxiv-2602-23601.description: Abstract Extended Reality (XR), encompassing Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), and Mixed Reality (MR), is revolutionizing education by creating immersive, interactive learning environments. This article explores the potential of XR to enhance student engagement, experiential learning, and skill development while addressing the challenges of widespread adoption.

britannica-1911-metochita-theodore.title: Metochita, Theodore (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-metochita-theodore.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-metochita-theodore.description: Article 'Metochita, Theodore' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Byzantine author, man of learning and statesman, who flourished during the reign of Andronicus II. Palaeologus (1282–1328). After the deposition of his patron by Andronicus III., Metochita was deprived of his office of great logothete (chancellor) and sent into exile. He was soon recalled, but retired from political life to a convent, where he died in 1332.

pmc-10537823.description: ObjectivesTo compare the rates and injury sites among competitors in European and Swiss karate tournaments and to identify differences in these incidence rates by sex and age.MethodsThis prospective cohort study collected data from two European and four national tournaments in Switzerland between 2011 and 2019.

pmc-11329845.title: Analysis of Demographic and Socioeconomic Factors Influencing Adherence to a Web-Based Intervention Among Patients After Acute Coronary Syndrome: Prospective Observational Cohort Study
pmc-11329845.creator: Biagio Sassone, Giuseppe Fuca', Mario Pedaci, Roberta Lugli, Enrico Bertagnin, Santo Virzi', Manuela Bovina, Giovanni Pasanisi, Simona Mandini, Jonathan Myers, Paolo Tolomeo
pmc-11329845.description: BackgroundAlthough telemedicine has been proven to have significant potential for improving care for patients with cardiac problems, there remains a substantial risk of introducing disparities linked to the use of digital technology, especially for older or socially vulnerable subgroups.ObjectiveWe investigated factors influencing adherence to a telemedicine-delivered health education intervention in patients with ischemia, emphasizing demographic and socioeconomic considerations.

pmc-11378528.title: Effect of green banana and pineapple fibre powder consumption on host gut microbiome
pmc-11378528.creator: Chun Wie Chong, Mei Shan Liew, Weitze Ooi, Hassan Jamil, Angie Lim, Suet Li Hooi, Clarisse S. C. Tay, Gwendoline Tan
pmc-11378528.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeTo determine whether green banana powder (GBP) and pineapple fibre powder (PFP) promote beneficial bacterial species, directly improve human gut health and modulate the gut microbiome and understand their utility as functional foods and dietary supplements.MethodsOver 14 days, 60 adults followed protocol requirements, completed food diaries and study questionnaires, avoided consuming supplements with prebiotics, probiotics or postbiotics, and ingested food containing 5 g of total daily fibre [placebo (10.75 g), GBP (10.75 g) or PFP (7.41 g)].

pmc-11518461.title: Population-based physical activity promotion with a focus on health equity: evidence challenges
pmc-11518461.creator: S Kohler, D Dippon, P Weber, A Ruetten, K Pfeifer, J Semrau
pmc-11518461.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IssuePhysical activity (PA) approaches that target the entire population hold great promise for public health particularly in terms of health equity due to their broad reach. During the process of developing national recommendations for PA and PA promotion in Germany, followed by a partial update, it became evident that there is limited evidence regarding population-based PA interventions with a focus on health equity.

pmc-11639151.title: PSA-HWT: handwritten font generation based on pyramid squeeze attention
pmc-11639151.creator: Hong Zhao, Jinhai Huang, Wengai Li, Zhaobin Chang, Weijie Wang
pmc-11639151.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The generator, which combines convolutional neural network (CNN) and Transformer as its core modules, serves as the primary model for the handwriting font generation network and demonstrates effective performance. However, there are still problems with insufficient feature extraction in the overall structure of the font, the thickness of strokes, and the curvature of strokes, resulting in subpar detail in the generated fonts.

pmc-11709814.title: Applying Digital Spatial Profiling of the Transcriptome to Elucidate Disease Mechanisms of Psychosis in Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-11709814.creator: Jacob Thomas‐Hegarty, Katie Lunnon, Ehsan Pishva, Adam Smith, Luke Weymouth, Michael Eyres, Lucy Frost, Gayle Marshall, Eleanor Platt, Byron Creese
pmc-11709814.description: BackgroundPsychosis occurs in 30‐40% of individuals with AD. New insights into disease mechanisms may lead to novel pharmacological targets and treatments. Previous studies have focused on bulk tissue analysis with limited results. Digital spatial profiling (DSP) is a new technique for spatial analysis of RNA or proteins in fixed tissue.

pmc-12530143.title: Brillouin microscopy in cancer research: a review
pmc-12530143.creator: Nathan Falkner, Meryem-Nur Duman, Zahra Zabolizadeh, Hadi Mahmodi, Chenjun Shi, Jitao Zhang, Thomas R. Cox, Irina Kabakova
pmc-12530143.description: .SignificanceCancer is one of the leading diseases worldwide, continuing to pose a significant financial burden to national health systems and taking lives. These drive the development of early-stage cancer diagnostics, which is believed to be a crucial step in improving patients’ life expectancy and long-term outcomes of cancer treatments.

pmc-12533551.title: Early Serum Calcium Assessment as a Cost-Effective Tool in Risk Stratification of Acute Pancreatitis
pmc-12533551.creator: Aakshaay Rastogi, Nitin Gupta, Esha Chaudhary, Akansha Aggarwal, Vikram Rajput
pmc-12533551.description: BackgroundAcute pancreatitis is a common gastrointestinal emergency that ranges from mild, self-limiting inflammation to severe disease with multi-organ dysfunction and high mortality. Traditional prognostic scoring systems such as Bedside Index for Severity in Acute Pancreatitis (BISAP) and CT Severity Index (CTSI) are useful but often complex.

pmc-12542494.title: Phage vB_KpnM_JYSS3 encodes a novel polysaccharide depolymerase that exhibits specific activity against K2-type carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae
pmc-12542494.creator: Shi-Yan Jiao, Xia Wang, Jie Wang, Ying-Ying Liu, Lu Zhang, Xiao-Cui Peng, Jia-Le Song, Chun-Miao Wang, Wei Zhang, Xiao-Jun Li
pmc-12542494.description: BackgroundCarbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (CRKP), a major nosocomial pathogen, poses an increasingly serious threat to human health.ResultsIn the quest for innovative therapeutic modalities to treat CRKP infections, a newly discovered phage, vB_KpnM_JYSS3, which can specifically infect and lyse K2-type CRKP, was isolated and subjected to an array of comprehensive characterizations and genome sequencing.

pmc-13620429.creator: Lucille Kelsall-Knight, Jennifer M Goldberg, Kelvin McMillan, Elizabeth K Darling, Charlene Downing
